offering_description.value: Publishes and sells digital and print instructional materials, assessments and learning platforms for schools, colleges and professionals. Sells mainly through school and college contracts and direct digital subscriptions, delivering content online and in print.

primary_products.value: digital courseware; textbooks; assessment software; adaptive learning platforms; professional certification materials

primary_services.value: professional development training; implementation and teacher support; assessment administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: K-12 school districts, colleges and universities, corporate and professional organizations; B2G: state education agencies and public school systems; B2C: individual students and professionals buying study or certification materials

end_markets.value: K-12 education; higher education; professional certification; corporate training

revenue_model.value: product sales: print textbooks and physical course materials; subscription: digital learning platforms and courseware licenses for schools and colleges; licensing or royalties: licensed content used by other publishers and institutions; service fees: training, implementation and assessment services
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and publishes educational content sold under its own brands, sold to schools and colleges; software / platform: operates digital learning and assessment platforms used by teachers and students; service provider: provides training and implementation services to districts and institutions
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with sales and content licensing in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: K-12 education, higher education and professional lines sharing content and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to school districts and colleges; online: digital subscriptions and online platforms for individual learners; third-party retail: bookstores and online retailers selling print and professional titles

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: student data privacy and education accessibility rules, such as FERPA and COPPA, applied to learning platforms
